messages.message: Parameter #1 $accessToken of method Modules\User\Models\BaseUser::passportWithAccessToken() expects Laravel\Passport\Contracts\ScopeAuthorizable|null, mixed given.

Method Modules\User\Models\OauthClient::owner() should return Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphTo<Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User, $this(Modules\User\Models\OauthClient)> but returns Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\MorphTo<Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model, $this(Modules\User\Models\OauthClient)>.
